appDesc.message: Sort your Instagram follows and saved posts into topics, then digest each topic.

noBookmarks.message: No digests yet. Open a topic in Saved and press “Make digest”.

syncingFollowers.message: Fetching your followers (to find mutual-follow friends)…

mergeHint.message: "$1" already exists. Enter merges the two topics and their digests.

confirmDeleteCat.message: Delete "$1"? Its $2 follows and saved posts become unsorted and the AI sorts them again on the next run. Its digests are deleted too.

rateLimited.message: Gemini rate limit. Retrying in $1 s…

loginFirst.message: Log in to instagram.com in this browser first.

igFailed.message: Could not read Instagram. Reload the instagram.com tab and sync again.

followingShrank.message: Got only $1 of $2 followed accounts, so the old list was kept. If you really unfollowed them, press Sync once more to accept the new list.

needKey.message: Synced. Add a Gemini API key in Settings to sort into topics.

refinePlaceholder.message: e.g. condense into formulas, like Sales = pain scenario + solution

confirmDeleteDigest.message: Delete this digest? Other digests in this topic are kept.

apiKeyHelp.message: Free key: aistudio.google.com/apikey. Stored only in this browser.

model.message: Sorting model (many calls: pick one with a high free quota)

summaryModel.message: Digest model (pick one that writes well)

quotaOut.message: Daily free quota for $1 is used up; it resets in about $2 h. Change the model in Settings or enable billing on the API key. Everything sorted so far is saved.

confirmResort.message: Re-sort everything? AI topics and all digests are rebuilt (topics you set by hand are kept); this uses many Gemini calls.

confirmClear.message: Delete all synced lists and digests? Settings are kept.
